BA.headline: Boeing Receives $136.57 Million Defense Contract
BA.summary: Boeing has been awarded contract actions valued at $136.57 million related to P-8A and Japan E-767 aircraft programs.

BA.headline: Boeing Board Members Purchase Company Stock
BA.summary: Boeing Chairman Steven Mollenkopf and director Mortimer “Tim” Buckley acquired approximately $1.51 million in company stock.

BA.headline: Boeing Awarded $119.7 Million U.S. Navy Contract Modification for P-8A Aircraft
BA.summary: Boeing received a $119.7 million contract modification from the U.S. Navy to provide retrofit A-kits for P-8A Poseidon aircraft.

BA.headline: Boeing Scores 140-Jet Avolon Order As Single-Aisle Demand Builds
BA.summary: Boeing 737-10 Order lifts Avolon’s backlog above 240 jets as Boeing forecasts stronger long-term Middle East aviation demand.

BA.headline: Boeing, Avolon Announce Finalized Purchase Of 140 737-10 Airplanes, Largest Single-Aisle Order By A Lessor
Boeing Releases Long-Term Aviation Forecast for the Middle East
BA.summary: Boeing projects that the Middle East's commercial aircraft fleet will double to over 3,500 planes by 2045, driven by regional travel growth.

BA.headline: Boeing Releases 2026 Commercial Market Outlook for China
BA.summary: Boeing projects that China will require 9,240 new commercial aircraft by 2045 as the country's airline fleet is expected to more than double.

BA.headline: Boeing Announces Travel Demand Propels Middle East Fleet To Double By 2045; Passenger Traffic In Middle East Is Forecast To Grow 4.3% Annually Despite Headwinds; Airlines In The Middle East Are Expected To Take Delivery Of Nearly 3K New Airplanes Over Next Two Decades; Around 85% Of Middle East Fleet In 2045 To Consist Of Modern, Fuel-Efficient Planes Delivered Over Next 20 Years; Fleet Growth In Middle East Will Drive $475B Investment In Commercial Aviation Services
Beacon AI Tests MURDOCK Pilot-Assistance Software on Boeing KC-46
BA.summary: Beacon AI successfully demonstrated its MURDOCK pilot-assistance software during operational testing on U.S. Air Force Boeing KC-46 refueling tankers.

BA.headline: Boeing Receives U.S. Authorization to Supply Spare Parts to Belavia
BA.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department has granted Boeing permission to resume providing spare parts and software to the Belarusian flag carrier, Belavia.

BA.headline: Boeing, Icelease Sign Agreement for Potential 767 Converted Freighters
BA.summary: Boeing and Icelease agree to convert one 767-300 aircraft, with options for two additional freighter conversions under the deal.

BA.headline: Boeing and Icelease Sign Agreement for 767-300 Converted Freighters
BA.summary: Boeing has entered into an agreement with Icelease to convert one 767-300 aircraft into a freighter, with options for two additional conversions.

BA.headline: Boeing Receives Order From Icelease For One 767-300 Converted Freighter, Options For Two More
Rothschild & Co Redburn Adjusts Price Target on Boeing
BA.summary: Rothschild & Co Redburn has revised its price target for The Boeing Company, lowering it from $285 to $225.

BA.headline: Ryanair CEO Comments on Boeing Production Challenges and 737 MAX 10 Timeline
BA.summary: Ryanair's CEO reported ongoing production challenges at Boeing, specifically regarding wings and engines, while providing an updated outlook for the 737 MAX 10 certification.
